component.name: Streamlink Chat
component.summary: Twitch, Kick and Steam TV chats in one window

description.p: A lightweight chat client for Twitch, Kick and Steam TV, in the style of Streamlink Launcher: one tab per chat, badges, emotes (Twitch, BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ, 7TV), mentions, light and dark themes, five languages. Reading needs no account.
